drawn.syntax:
# Structural model
M ~ NA*"a"*X
Y ~ NA*"b"*M
Y ~ NA*"cp"*X

# Variances and covariances
X ~~ X
M ~~ M
Y ~~ Y
ind := a*b
total := cp + ind

fit.script:
# Forma analysis; lavaan 0.7.3
# R version 4.6.0 (2026-04-24)
# Place the original source file in the working directory.
library(lavaan)

i <- seq_len(400)
X <- sin(i*.37) + cos(i*.11)
M <- .6*X + sin(i*.71) + .4*cos(i*.17)
Y <- .45*M + .2*X + cos(i*.53) + .2*sin(i*.29)
data <- data.frame(X, M, Y)


fit <- sem(
  model = "# Structural model\nM ~ NA*\"a\"*X\nY ~ NA*\"b\"*M\nY ~ NA*\"cp\"*X\n\n# Variances and covariances\nX ~~ X\nM ~~ M\nY ~~ Y\nind := a*b\ntotal := cp + ind",
  data = data,
  estimator = "ML",
  missing = "listwise",
  fixed.x = FALSE,
  meanstructure = FALSE
)
summary(fit, fit.measures = TRUE, standardized = TRUE, rsquare = TRUE)
parameterEstimates(fit, standardized = TRUE, level = 0.95, boot.ci.type = "perc")
